content: Ananiyas edde Safira
Ehon, Ananiyas name ekzon manuš edde hitar bou Safiraye ekkan zobin šombotti beisse.
Hite ṭiyattu hodun nizolla raki diyore baki ṭiyagun asab okkolor ṭengor ḍake raikkegoi, ar hite hen goijjede hitar bouwe o furafuri zanito.
Hetunot Fitore hodde, "Ananiyas, Šoitane tor mon kengori dokol goijje, ziyanor zoriya tui Pak Ruhur hãse misa hota hoiyos edde zobin besa ṭiyattu hodun nizolla raki diyos?

Besibar age ki zobingan tor nu aššil ne? Ar besi bade o ki ṭiyagun tor hatot nu aššil ne? To kiyolla tui endilla ham goribi ṭik goijjos? Tui šude mainšor loi misa no hos, kintu Allar loi misa hoiyos."
Ei hota funi mottor Ananiyas meṛit fori mori giyegoi. Ei goṭonar hota zara fuinne hitara beggune beša beši ḍoraiye.
Bade hozon zuwan manuš aišše edde hitar gat kafonor hor berai diye edde bare loi zai hitare dohon gorai felaiye.
Iyar tin gonḍa bade Ananiyasor bou heṛe aišše, kintu ki oiye hin hibaye no zanito.
Fitore hibare fusar goredde, "Sai ho sai, tũwara zobin besiyore beggun failade in ne ki?" Hibaye hodde, "Oi hin beggun in."
Hetunot Fitore hodde, "Tũwara kengori Mabudor Ruhure entehan goribolla razi oila? Sa, ze mainše tor zamaire dohon goraito aišše hitara dorozar hãsat aišše, ar hitara tore o baire loizaibo."
Safira hetunot Fitoror ṭengor ḍake mori giyegoi. Ar he zuwan manuš okkole butore aiyore dekedde hiba mora, toi hibare baire loizai hibar zamair ḍakottu dohon goraiye.
Hetunot zomator manuš edde oinno zara he hota fuinne hitara beggune beši ḍoraiye.
Sinno edde keramot
Asab okkolor duwara bout ḍoilla keramot edde sinnor ham okkol mainšor maze gora oiye. Ar biššaši okkol beggune dórmogóror Soloimanor haissarat ekku fũwati dola oito.
Oinno hono mainše hitarar loi dola oibolla himmot no gorito, zodi o hitarare manuš okkole kub beši ijjot gorito.
Ar din din bout furuš edde mayafuwain okkol Malikor uwore biššaš ainne edde Malikor dolor fũwati zug goijje.

Ar manuš okkole biyaraimma okkolore rastar uwore bar gori ani haṭor uwore edde faṛir uwore neṛai rakito, zene rasta bai zaibar šomot ebbe no oile Fitoror sabagan oile hitarar hono hono kiyor uwore fore.
Zeruzalemor atehasor fara okkolottu bout manuš okkole hitarar biyaraimma okkolore edde horaf zine faiyede manuš okkolore bar gori anito edde hitara beggune aram oito.
Isar sahabi okkolor uwore zulum
Hetunot ḍõr imam edde hitar har sãti okkol, zara Sadduki dolor manuš, hitara riše zoli uiṭṭe.
Hitara asab okkolore dori šorkari ziyolot diye.
Kintu raitta Mabudor ekzon firistaye ziyolor dorozagun kuli hitarare hentu baire niyalai ani hodde,
"Zo, tũwara dórmogóror uṛanot tiyaiore manuš okkolore ei noya zibonor babute har hóbor hogoi."

Ei hota funiyore tarfore binna kub sore hitara dórmogórot giye edde šikka diya šuru goijje. Toi heṛe maze, ḍõr imam edde hitar fũwajja okkol, zara Sadduki dol, mani Israili okkolor murubbi neta beggunore loi ek ḍõr bisar muzoliš ḍaikke edde asab okkolore anibolla hoekzon manušore ziyolot defeṛaiye.
Kintu zehon faharadar okkol heṛe aišše, heṛe hitarare no fa. Hitara uwafes firi zaiyore ei hóbor hoiyegoi,
"Ãra ziyolor doroza mojbut gori ṭala lagaiya asede edde doroza doroza faharadar okkol tiyai roiyede lot faiyi, kintu doroza kuli honokiyore butore no dekilam."
Ei hota funi dórmogór sõloya garḍ okkolor boro edde ḍõr imam okkol suhara oi bafa šuru goijje, iyanor anzam ki oibo,hoi.
Hetunot ekzon manuš aiyore hodde, "So, ze manuš okkolore tũwara ziyolot dila hitara dórmogóror uṛanot tiyaiyore mainšore šikka der."
Hetunot faharadar okkolor boroye hitar manuš okkol loi zaiyore hitarare dori ainne. Kintu mainše fattor maribo ḍore hitara asab okkolor uwore hono zobodusti no gore.
Hitara asab okkolore aniyore bisar šobar sarme tiya goraiye. Hetunot ḍõr imame asab okkolore hodde:
"Ãra tũwarare hora bafe hokum dilam he namor babute šikka no dibolla, kintu tũwara tũwarar šikkare Zeruzalemor aga gura borai felaiyo, edde he manušwar louwor dai ãrare goitto sor."
Hetunot Fitor edde oinno asab okkole zuwab dedde: "Manušor hokum falon goribattuwaro bolke Allar hokum ãra falon goronnan zoruri!
Zare õnora ek gasor uwore ṭaikko edde mari felaiyo, ãrar baf dadar Allaye he Isare morattu uwafes tuille.
Allaye hibare badša edde Basailoya hisabe hibar ḍen ḍakottu boibar ijjot diye, zene hibaye Israili okkolore gunattu mon firat ani fare edde gunar maf di fare.
Ãra in beggunor babute goba, ar zara Allar baiddo o, hitarare Allaye he Pak Ruhure diye, he Pak Ruh o hibar goba."
Ei hota funi hitara guššaye oin oiye edde hitarare furai felaibolla ereda loiye.
Kintu he bisar šobattu Gamaliel name ekzon Foroši alem, zare hár mainše ijjot goitto, hiba tiyai giyegoi edde ei manuššunore hotun baire loizai raka oibolla hokum diye.
Tarfore hibaye ḍõr šobare hodde: "Israili okkol! Tũwara ei manuššunore kissu goribar age bala gori bafi so.

Oto! kissu din age Tevdas name ekzon manuš muntu aišše, hitare hite ekzon ḍõr manuš dabi goijjil, ar hom beši sair šot mainše hitar fũwati zug dil. Hitare mari fela oiye edde hitar har sãti okkol šiṛašitta oi giyegoi edde hãzi giyegoi.
Hite bade, manuš gona oibar šomot endilla oilo, Galilot Ehudaye ek dol manušore failo, kintu hite o mori giyegoi, ar hitar sãti okkol beggun šiṛašiṭṭa oi giyegoi.
Hetolla ãi tũwarare hoir: Ei manuš okkolore kissu no goijjo. Itarare sari do, kiyollahoile itarar moksud edde haz harbar zodi manušor torfottu oi take, toile hin dongšo oi zaiboi.
Kintu zodi Allar torfottu o, toile tũwara itarare tamai no fariba. Hetolla hũšiyar! Ar no oile šude dekiba, tũwara Allar berudde larai goror."
Toi hitara hibar mošowarat razi oiye. Hitara asab okkolore abar butore ḍaki ainne edde hitarare bet marabaiye. Tarfore hitarare Isar nam loi tobolig no goribolla hokum diyore bade eri diye.
Henot Isar namolla buli asab okkole ze ohomani oibar laikka oiye, hiyanolla kuši gori gori hitara he bisar šobattu giyegoi.
Hitara fotti din dórmogórot edde góre góre zai šikka diye, hitara hinore tiya gorai no fele, Isa ze Mosi he kušir hóbor tobolig gorat aššil.
